title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify bearer resources.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to modify EPS bearer context.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request modification of bearer resources.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to reject bearer resource modification request.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity for packet filter
entities.description: IE containing EPS bearer identity used in bearer resource modification request.

entities.name: Unknown EPS bearer context
entities.description: Condition where EPS bearer identity does not belong to any activated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: PDN connection established for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where bearer resource modification is requested for emergency PDN connection.

entities.name: Collision of UE requested bearer resource modification and EPS bearer context modification
entities.description: Condition where both UE-initiated and network-initiated bearer modification procedures occur simultaneously.

entities.name: MME rejects with ESM cause #43
entities.description: MME behavior to reject request with cause #43 'invalid EPS bearer identity'.

entities.name: MME rejects with ESM cause #30
entities.description: MME behavior to reject request with cause #30 'request rejected by Serving GW or PDN GW'.

entities.name: Handling as described in clause 6.4.3.6
entities.description: Procedure collision handling follows the same rules as specified in clause 6.4.3.6.

relations.description: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity for packet filter IE.
Unknown EPS bearer context condition leads to MME rejecting with cause #43.
Emergency PDN connection condition leads to MME rejecting with cause #30.
Procedure collision condition leads to handling as specified in clause 6.4.3.6.
MME rejection with cause #43 is implemented by sending BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message.
MME rejection with cause #30 is implemented by sending BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message.
